sectionIntro.title: About the platform
sectionIntro.quote: i-Recognize is the flagship KPMG platform where collaboration takes flight. We honor teams that move with the precision and speed of a hummingbird, creating global impact.
paragraphs: Our approach ensures every story of success is documented with corporate rigor and artistic flair, reflecting the core values of KPMG.
Through structured showcases reviewed by a jury, impactful work is recognized across defined categories as part of the platform experience.

awards.title: Award Categories
awards.subtitle: Celebrating excellence across 8 core categories that define the spirit of innovation and collective impact at i-Recognize.

categories.title: Design Brilliance
categories.text: Recognizes work where thoughtful design and strong visual consistency come together, showcasing craftsmanship and purposeful execution.

categories.title: Digital Velocity
categories.text: Recognizes projects delivered with speed and agility to adapt quickly to change while maintaining quality, balance, and impact.

categories.title: Content Impact
categories.text: Acknowledges communicables that tell a powerful, clear, and concise story, driving and inspiring meaningful action.

categories.title: Motion Flow
categories.text: Recognizes projects where motion and transitions were used purposefully to elevate the user experience effortlessly.

categories.title: Creative Spark
categories.text: Acknowledges new ideas and fresh approaches - where curiosity, clarity, and intent sparked meaningful innovation.

categories.title: Result Momentum
categories.text: Recognizes a body of work with measurable impact - built through steady and consistent effort over time.

categories.title: Story Clarity
categories.text: Recognizes work that connected with clarity and emotional resonance. Impactful stories that convey complex ideas engage easily.

categories.title: Collective Choice
categories.text: Recognizes work that connected across teams, fostering strong collaboration and collective success across diverse organizational functions.

steps.title: Final Jury
steps.desc: Exclusive presentation to the global jury for final winner selection.

steps.title: Gala Night
steps.desc: Grand celebration and live announcement of the i-Recognize 2026 winners.

steps.title: Legacy
steps.desc: Continuous archival of recognized stories in the platform's hall of fame.

themeSection.title: The Hummingbird: Resilience & Agility
paragraphs: In 2026, we celebrate the spirit of the Hummingbird. Small in stature but immense in impact, it represents the agility, speed, and tireless energy that defines our collective journey.
Just as the hummingbird finds the sweetest nectar through determination, we seek out the best in our teams, acknowledging the small efforts that lead to grand achievements.

bePart.title: Be Part of the Platform
bePart.contentTop: Whether you're learning, solving, creating, or improving — i-Recognize is your platform to be seen and heard.
bePart.contentBottom: Connect with your and take part in a shared journey of showcasing, learning, and recognition.
